codec.note: 77 nonempty recognized control nets reindexed; 2 empty nets unchanged; 1 opaque-tail file rejected for rewriting. Synthetic format branches also validate references and byte-preserved unrelated blocks.

time_accounting.note: Several focused diagnostic regressions also ran. Coding, investigation, packaging and review were not separately timed; remaining wall time is not test waiting.

notes: Native geometry, IDs, history, scenes, DXF and sections are compared without new floating tolerances.
Face deletion intentionally retains legacy wire-edge semantics. Free-curve endpoint normalization is included before native persistence.
Live point-edge order is session data, not an FBM extension. Direct split-then-collapse and undo/redo are separately covered.
Advanced modeling, constraint definitions, other FBM fields, old-version conversion, four-view mesh and professional calculations still have Pascal dependencies.
Hidden Qt callback tests are not physical desktop or complete visual acceptance. Reusable sources are retained; outputs/builds are on C.
